decision.rationale: The update accepts a pet without status while its inline request schema requires status. Handler behavior and nullable model fields do not independently establish the intended request requirement.

scope.tests_and_docs: Package-local test directories, README/API prose and linked DTO/service/serialization files only.

manual_fallback.notes: Pet.status is nullable at model/Pet.java:34; shared Pet schema only requires name/photoUrls, whereas the inline PUT schema adds status. The schema disagreement and handler echo are comparison context, not independent intent evidence.

coverage_resolution: Manual handler and field review supplements the lexical scan.
